design.acceptance: In each carrier add at least four useful locations on three distinct recordings. Preserve earlier findings. Allow at most one new ordinary control flag per carrier and zero additions on the constant offset and synchronized picture and mouth controls.
design.method: After the two existing passes, compare 80 ms windows every 20 ms at the existing quiet floor. Retain 0.86 correlation, the alternative-peak margin, four supporting shifted windows and two same-time windows per flank. Keep both existing picture grids and bounds.
design.scope: Four-second 720p25 MP4/MOV pairs with identical clock. Edits of 320 or 480 ms on the native picture clock. Useful requires correct shift within 16 samples and temporal IoU of at least 0.50.
